name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop
description: Electron desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness
author: DeepSeek

scripts.build:installer: pnpm --dir ../.. run build && pnpm --dir ../.. run desktop:runtime && node ../../scripts/verify-desktop-runtime.mjs && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.build:installer:win: pnpm --dir ../.. run build && pnpm --dir ../.. run desktop:runtime && node ../../scripts/verify-desktop-runtime.mjs && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --publish never
scripts.build:installer:mac: pnpm --dir ../.. run build && pnpm --dir ../.. run desktop:runtime && node ../../scripts/verify-desktop-runtime.mjs && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.build:installer:linux: pnpm --dir ../.. run build && pnpm --dir ../.. run desktop:runtime && node ../../scripts/verify-desktop-runtime.mjs && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux AppImage deb --publish never
scripts.release: pnpm --dir ../.. run build && pnpm --dir ../.. run desktop:runtime && node ../../scripts/verify-desktop-runtime.mjs && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish always
